purpose: Collect a browser-native time value when platform-specific time input is intentional.
accessibility: Expose a visible label or stable accessible name for the native input.
Preserve the platform's keyboard, touch, validation, and disabled semantics.
responsive: Uses the platform time control without changing the field contract.
Retains shared control geometry and focus treatment.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.

api.name: value
api.description: Current native time value in HH:mm form.

api.name: onChange
api.description: Callback fired by the native time control.
